analysis.headline: No Sharing for Marketing
analysis.quote: We do not share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.

analysis.headline: Shares with Phone Verifiers
analysis.quote: Disclosed to Payment processors and phone verification service providers

analysis.headline: Shares with Fraud Providers
analysis.quote: Disclosed to Service providers that help us combat fraud/abuse

analysis.headline: Shares for Legal Compliance
analysis.quote: We may share some or all of the above listed data in the following circumstances: to respond to subpoenas, search warrants, court orders, or other legal process.

analysis.headline: Ignores 'Do Not Track'
analysis.quote: We do not respond to "Do Not Track" signals (see allaboutdnt.com).

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored in US
analysis.quote: By accessing CL or providing us data, you agree we may use and disclose data we collect as described here or as communicated to you, transmit it outside your resident jurisdiction, and store it on servers in the United States.

analysis.headline: Security Guarantees Not Made
analysis.quote: We make good faith efforts to store data securely, but can make no guarantees.

analysis.headline: Content Not Fully Removed
analysis.quote: Please note that removal does not ensure complete or comprehensive removal of said content or information from the Internet.
